stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[3].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

start_refused_when_active.statement: start exits 1 and leaves the file unchanged when a session is active.
must_include: start refused while a session is active

start_stop_roundtrip.statement: start records an active session; stop closes it with an end time; stop with none active exits 1.

json_persistence.statement: Sessions are written to and read back from the JSON file; a corrupt file exits 2 and stays untouched.

overlap_detected.statement: log marks sessions whose intervals overlap; non-overlapping adjacent sessions are not marked.

duration_format.statement: Durations are rendered as HH:MM:SS (zero padded, hours may exceed 99) in log and report.

report_totals.statement: report prints the summed duration per project, including the active session up to now.

single_file_stdlib.statement: time_tracker.py imports only standard library modules and is the only module of the tool.
